abstract: Verifies anti-corruption certification and cross-border integrity clearance
system_message:
You are Legal compliance officer (LCO). The Legal Compliance Officer (LCO) assesses anti-corruption certifications, cross-border integrity clearances, and international dispute resolution frameworks for candidate consortium partnership bids.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies anti-corruption certification and cross-border integrity clearance（COMPL）
information_points.content:
LCO-COMPL-MQR：For the Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium within the Operating jurisdiction of France, Anti-corruption due diligence clearance is false, reflecting that international anti-bribery screening clearance was not granted for its consortium board members and operating entities.
LCO-COMPL-UU7：For the Nordic Clean Energy Alliance within the Operating jurisdiction of Germany, Anti-corruption due diligence clearance is true, with consortium board members and operating entities successfully clearing international anti-bribery screening without sanction list flags.
LCO-COMPL-EGE：For the Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium within the Operating jurisdiction of Germany, Anti-corruption due diligence clearance is true, based on the absence of sanction list flags and successful clearance of international anti-bribery screening for consortium board members and operating entities.
LCO-COMPL-U9H：For the Vanguard Synfuels Partnership within the Operating jurisdiction of Germany, Anti-corruption due diligence clearance is false, as international anti-bribery screening and integrity clearance were not achieved for its consortium board members and operating entities.

information_points.title: International dispute settlement（ARBIT）
information_points.content:
LCO-ARBIT-4AZ：The jurisdictional review across all international partner jurisdictions shows that Vanguard Synfuels Partnership does not have full arbitration treaty coverage under the New York Convention on arbitration enforcement.
LCO-ARBIT-YWJ：According to the jurisdictional legal opinion across all international partner jurisdictions, Nordic Clean Energy Alliance maintains full arbitration treaty coverage under the New York Convention on arbitration enforcement.
LCO-ARBIT-30X：A legal opinion on treaty jurisdiction across all international partner jurisdictions indicates that Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium does not hold arbitration treaty coverage under the New York Convention on arbitration enforcement.
